# blendops-glb-web-handoff (reference summary)

## Purpose
Prepare GLB handoff to web teams, including animation clips and a React Three Fiber component plan.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blendops-glb-web-handoff/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blendops-glb-web-handoff/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `evidence-and-handoff` / `glb-web-animation-and-r3f-handoff`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- A GLB is going to a web team.
- Animation clips must be named and documented.
- A React Three Fiber component plan is needed.

## Trigger cues
- "prepare web handoff"
- "is GLB ready"
- "summarize export status"
- "make it loop"
- "trigger animation on hover"
- "idle and active states"
- "smooth transition between"
- "how should the React component look"
- "what props should I expose"
- "ref shape for the model"
- "we use react-three-fiber"

## When not to use
- to claim GLB or export success without concrete evidence → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-final-check)
- to replace runtime export verification → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-final-check)
- to validate upstream scene readiness → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; use blendops-final-check)
- to classify raw render/export artifact evidence → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; use blendops-final-check)
- to define mobile or file-size performance budgets → delegate to `blendops-glb-budget` (`references/skills/blendops-glb-budget.md`; use blendops-glb-budget)
- to write the final user-facing response wording → delegate to `blendops-start` (`references/skills/blendops-start.md`; use blendops-start)
- video pre-renders → delegate to `blendops-render-settings` (`references/skills/blendops-render-settings.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-render-settings)
- platforms that re-author animation downstream (game engines re-rigging the asset) → delegate to `blendops-product-shot` (`references/skills/blendops-product-shot.md`; game engines re-rigging the asset)
- the GLB is rendered server-side (e.g. AR pre-render); no React component needed → delegate to `blendops-start` (`references/skills/blendops-start.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-start)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `verified_or_planned_glb_artifact` (`object`): GLB artifact evidence record (from blendops-final-check) or planned export specification
- `target_web_viewer_stack` (`string`): Target web runtime (Three.js, React Three Fiber, <model-viewer>, Babylon.js)

### Optional inputs
- `animation_and_budget_contracts` (`object`): Optional linked contracts from blendops-glb-web-handoff and blendops-glb-budget
- `animation_clip_inventory` (`array`): List of NLA/action clips with frame lengths, FPS, and skeletal/morph types
- `interactive_playback_triggers` (`object`): Target loop/one-shot semantics, crossfade durations, root-motion policy, and consumer triggers
- `mobile_rig_budget_ceilings` (`object`): Bone count, morph target, and keyframe channel ceilings from blendops-glb-budget
- `glb_delivery_contract` (`object`): Locked GLB node hierarchy, material slots, and compression spec from blendops-glb-web-handoff
- `r3f_version_and_use_case` (`object`): Target @react-three/fiber major version (8 vs 9) and interactive component use case
- `animation_clip_contract` (`object`): Optional clip names, triggers, and crossfade rules from blendops-glb-web-handoff

### Primary outputs
- `web_glb_delivery_handoff_packet`
- `scale_orientation_and_compression_manifest`
- `viewer_integration_caveats`
- `per_clip_animation_contract_table`
- `root_motion_and_interpolation_pins`
- `consumer_playback_verification_checklist`
- `r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec`
- `suspense_caching_and_dispose_contract`
- `consumer_call_site_usage_outline`
